thread:
incident-bot: HIGH: increased 5xx/timeouts from /v1/generate (us-west-2). alert fired 2026-03-15T11:02:03Z. linked runbook: https://ir.redwood/INC-2026-122 :rotating_light:

shivani: grabbing this — dashboards show p95 jump and a clear spike in 502/504 + gateway timeouts. routing errors tied to prefix-cache layer. paging @oncall

samir: joined. quick grep shows repeated KV read failures + checksum errors from prefix-cache nodes. snippet:
```
[t=11:03:07.123] svc=prefix-cache node=pc-23 shard=14 ERROR KV_ERR_CHECKSUM_MISMATCH key=prefix:abc123
[t=11:03:07.125] svc=prefix-cache RETRY attempt=3 key=prefix:abc123 latency=150ms
[t=11:03:07.130] gateway gen-api 502 upstream_error pref-cache-timeout
```

ops-bot: Note: a compaction batch (compaction-job-v2) finished at 2026-03-15T10:47Z. PREFETCH_ENABLED=true flag rolled out at 2026-03-15T10:40Z to us-west-2.

marco: correlating compaction + prefetch — eviction queue depth on pc-23 jumped ~0 -> 1300 in ~40s. classic eviction storm pattern.

jess: CS triage: AcmeSearch (acme-77) hitting ~30% failure on generate, NovaDocs seeing intermittent gaps. notifying accounts.

shivani: mitigation proposal: 1) disable prefetch; 2) introduce routing fallback to bypass prefix cache for a fraction of traffic. doing step 1 now.

samir: applying config patch:
```
kubectl -n infra patch cm/prefix-cache-config -p '{"data":{"PREFETCH_ENABLED":"false"}}'
```

samir: patch applied to us-west-2. rolling restart of prefix-cache pods started. watching rollout.

ops-bot: Restart event: prefix-cache pods pc-21/pc-22/pc-23 terminating -> restarting at 2026-03-15T11:06:12Z.

marco: metrics: error-rate dropping 8% -> 3% in ~90s. still a tail of 502s coming from shards 12-16. eviction_queue_depth remains non-zero for some shards.

luis: taking lead for live mitigation. shivani handing off. I can flip routing to a bypass variant. plan: 20% canary -> 100% if stable.

shivani: handoff ack. root cause suspicion: compaction TTL recompute bug produced zero TTLs for merged segments which forced mass eviction and checksum mismatches; prefetch amplified working set size.

luis: creating canary: apply route policy to divert 20% to cache-bypass model variant. command (pseudo):
```
PATCH /v1/routes/generate {"region":"us-west-2","policy":{"prefix_cache_bypass_pct":20}}
```

luis: canary applied at 11:12:30Z. monitoring: canary traffic 0% 5xx. overall errors down to ~1.6%. holding for 5m.

jess: update: AcmeSearch errors on their requests that hit canary reduced from 30% -> 7%. CS loop updated.

ops-bot: metric: shard 14 eviction_queue_depth ~800; KV backend error-rate falling but not zero.

marco: suggestion: add quick compaction throttle — reduce parallel compaction to 2 per node + exponential backoff to avoid re-triggering eviction storms.

samir: opened MR for compaction backoff + ttl-sanity checks: https://git.redwood/infra/prefix-cache/merge_requests/438. will hold merge until after emergency rollback of prefetch.

luis: confidence high. moving to 100% bypass for region at 11:20Z to fully stabilize.

ops-bot: Route policy updated: prefix_cache_bypass_pct=100 for us-west-2 at 2026-03-15T11:20:11Z.

marco: after 100% bypass error-rate ~0.2%, p99 latency restored. no fresh 502 spikes. mitigation successful.

jess: CS confirms customer traffic largely healthy. prepping customer comms + credits offer.

shivani: hot notes/RCA draft:
- trigger: compaction-job-v2 merged segments at 10:47Z with TTL recompute bug -> some merged keys got TTL=0
- consequence: massive eviction for shards 12-16, checksum mismatches for some prefixes, KV read retries and gateway timeouts (502/504)
- amplifying factor: PREFETCH_ENABLED=true increased in-memory usage and eviction pressure; no eviction_queue circuit breaker.

samir: supporting logs: 
```
[t=10:47:12.456] compaction shard=14 merged=120 old_ttl=259200 new_ttl=0
[t=10:47:12.459] kv-store apply: write 0 bytes -> eviction triggered for >5000 prefixes
[t=11:03:07.123] ERROR KV_ERR_CHECKSUM_MISMATCH key=prefix:xyz
```

luis: short-term action items:
- keep prefix-cache bypass in us-west-2 until compaction fix + shard rebuild verified (ETA ~4-6h)
- add alert for eviction_queue_depth and implement circuit-breaker to suspend prefetch when threshold hit
- patch compaction to include TTL floor and integrity checks
- schedule customer postmortem invites and send final RCA

jess: I'll send proactive notes to impacted accounts (AcmeSearch, NovaDocs). offering 1:1 tech review and credits.

ops-bot: INCIDENT INC-2026-122 assigned to @luis; severity: sev2; started: 2026-03-15T11:02:03Z. state: mitigated — follow-ups: RCA, postmortem, config hardening.

shivani: I'll stub the postmortem doc and include timeline + logs + proposed infra changes.

samir: must add compaction-integrity unit test to prevent TTL underflow to zero and add preflight check for new compaction configs.

marco: backlog items created: limit prefetch concurrency, eviction_queue circuit-breaker, canonical hotshard rebuild with exponential backoff.

luis: closing slack incident thread — resolved via full cache bypass; root cause tracked; action items created. :white_check_mark:

jess: final customer updates sent; two accounts flagged for postmortem call.

participants reacted with :thumbsup: :raised_hands:.
